items.exampleEn: Ancient coffins were often made of stone.
items.exampleZh: 古代的棺材常常是用石頭做的。

items.exampleEn: Many temples have a statue of a goddess.
items.exampleZh: 很多寺廟裡都有一尊女神像。

items.exampleEn: Oppression makes people afraid to speak.
Clean water is one of mankind's basic needs.
items.exampleZh: 乾淨的水是人類的基本需求之一。

items.exampleEn: The new machine liberated workers from boring jobs.
items.exampleZh: 新機器把工人從無聊的工作中解放出來。

items.exampleEn: Music can unify people from different cultures.
items.exampleZh: 音樂能讓來自不同文化的人團結在一起。

items.exampleEn: The singer has a heavenly voice.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手有著美妙的嗓音。

items.sentenceEn: The museum shows how mankind learned to use fire.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館展示人類如何學會用火。

items.audioEn: Please don't touch the coffin; it is more than two thousand years old.
items.audioZh: 請不要碰那口棺材，它已經有兩千多年的歷史了。
items.questionZh: 為什麼不能碰那口棺材？

items.sentenceEn: Many families faced hardship when the factory closed.
items.sentenceZh: 工廠關閉後，很多家庭陷入困境。

items.sentenceEn: The old story is about a goddess who lives on the moon.
items.sentenceZh: 這個古老的故事講的是一位住在月亮上的女神。

items.stemEn: The coach tried to ____ the players after their big fight.
items.stemZh: 教練在球員大吵一架後試著讓他們團結。

items.stemEn: The weather on our beach trip was ____: sunny, warm, and not too hot.
items.stemZh: 我們去海邊玩時天氣美好極了：晴朗、溫暖，又不會太熱。

items.passageEn: My grandmother told me an old story. Long ago, a cruel king controlled the land, and the people lived under oppression. Farmers faced great hardship because the king took most of their crops. One day, a goddess came down from the sky. With her heavenly power, she liberated the people. She also unified the small villages so that they could work together. When the king died, he was buried in a plain wooden coffin. Before leaving, the goddess told the people, "Mankind must always help one another."
items.passageZh: 奶奶跟我說了一個古老的故事。很久以前，一位殘暴的國王掌控這片土地，人民生活在壓迫之下。農民的處境非常艱苦，因為國王拿走了他們大部分的作物。有一天，一位女神從天而降。她用天上的力量解救了人民，也讓各個小村莊團結起來，可以一起合作。國王死後，被葬在一口簡樸的木棺裡。女神離開前告訴人們：「人類一定要互相幫助。」

questions.questionZh: 女神離開前對人們說了什麼？
options: 要永遠記得國王的恩情
她明年還會再回來看大家

items.promptZh: 這本書講的是人們如何反抗壓迫。
referenceEn: This book is about how people fought against oppression.
The book tells how people fought oppression.
rubricZh: oppression 表示「壓迫」，是不可數名詞，例如 fight against oppression 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說書的內容用現在簡單式，說歷史用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 這項發明改變了人類的生活方式。
referenceEn: This invention has changed the way mankind lives.
This invention changed mankind's way of life.
rubricZh: 用 mankind 表示「人類」（例如 the way mankind lives）
「生活方式」可寫，例如 the way mankind lives、way of life 等；時態可用 changed、has changed 等
